headline:
Explosive growth,
priced for perfection
chart_note: 10-day range: $171.54 - $186.29. Up 8% over the window, part of a 52% run over the past month.
why_today: Up 52% over the past month on continued AI-platform demand - revenue and earnings both growing near or above 90% YoY.
pro_1: Revenue up 93% YoY and earnings up over 200% YoY, with a 49% profit margin
pro_2: Analyst sentiment mostly positive (20 Buy/Strong Buy vs. 10 Hold, 2 Sell)
con_1: Trading at 159x trailing earnings (115x forward) - among the richest valuations in the market
con_2: PEG ratio of 2.49 suggests the growth, however strong, is more than fully priced in already
